title: The future of food
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which change to food seems most likely in the next twenty years: lab-grown meat, insect protein, personalised diets, or something else?
Would you eat food produced in a laboratory if it were safe, affordable, and environmentally friendly?
How much tradition should matter when new food technologies are introduced?
Could technology make healthy food more available, or mainly create expensive products for wealthy consumers?
If you could redesign one part of today's food system, what would you change?
